subtitle: UPDATE Aug 19, 46 days from the first round and on the FOURTH DAY OF THE OFFICIAL CAMPAIGN. THE DISTANCE BETWEEN LULA AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO NARROWED FOR THE THIRD DAY RUNNING and closed at 30.95pp, against 37.05pp on Aug 16, in a presidential book that has accumulated USD 129.21M. And the move has only one side: LULA stayed at 63.50% for the second day, and the one who moved was FLÁVIO BOLSONARO, on a sixth day running of gains. NO new national poll: the latest is still BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 (n=2,003, field Aug 14 to 16, BR-03317/2026). The national Datafolha publishes on Aug 21 and is the first to measure Pablo Marçal.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 63.50% (vol USD 8.69M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC)
fortes: Today's BTG/Nexus puts him at 41% in the first round, up 1 point against the same house's previous round, which had him at 40%.
In the stimulated runoff he appears with 47% against 44%, a result IDENTICAL to the house's previous round, keeping the 3-point advantage.
The distance to the runner-up in the poll stays at 5 points, the same as the previous round, meaning the challenger's gain did not shorten the measured interval.
In the price he remains far ahead, at 64.50% against 31.45%, and his contract holds USD 8.52M inside a presidential book of USD 126.85M.
The high of the 88-day series recorded since May 22 is still 66.50%, from Aug 1, and today's close is among the 23 days on which the price marked 63.50% or above.
fracos: 🔴 A 2.00pp DROP in the price in one day, from 66.50% to 64.50%, giving back exactly what he had gained the day before.
The distance to the runner-up in the price CLOSED from 37.05pp to 33.05pp, that is 4.00pp in about 26 hours.
The government assessment in today's BTG/Nexus has 42% rating it bad or terrible against 34% excellent or good, with 23% average.
⛔ No upside superlative applies: the series high remains 66.50%, from Aug 1, and today's value sits below it.

The Federal Police found a message in which his son and a lobbyist under investigation for INSS fraud discuss business, and the runner-up and his brother used the case the same day, according to Poder360.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 63.50% (vol USD 8.69M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC), UNCHANGED for a second day running. ⭐ THE DISTANCE to the runner-up narrowed 0.50pp to 30.95pp, the THIRD day running of convergence, adding up to 6.10pp since Aug 16. 🔑 And the narrowing did not come from him: in two days he lost no price at all, and the entire convergence is the opponent rising. 📌 THE BALLOT BOX STAYS SILENT: no new national poll since Aug 17, and that one measured the distance between the two UNCHANGED at 5 points. A measurement that does not narrow cannot explain a narrowing of 6.10pp. 📊 In a STATE poll in the Federal District he stands at 39% against 44% in the runoff and is approved by 54% of that electorate, according to CNN Brasil; state polls do not enter the national panel. ⛔ No superlative: the high of the 88-day series is still 66.50%, from Aug 1. 📅 National Datafolha on Aug 21.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 32.55% (vol USD 8.63M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC)
fortes: 🔴 A 2.00pp RISE in the price in one day, from 29.45% to 31.45%, and it is the fourth straight day of gains.
The distance to the leader in the price CLOSED 4.00pp in about 26 hours, from 37.05pp to 33.05pp.
Today's BTG/Nexus takes him from 35% to 36% in the first round, and in the runoff he repeats the 44% of the previous round.
He dominates the first-round second place contract with 85.50%, far ahead of the next name in that book.
The negative assessment of the incumbent administration stands at 42% bad or terrible in the same BTG/Nexus.
fracos: ⛔ Not a record: of the 88 days in the series since May 22, 2 posted a value equal to or above today's close, and the high is still 33.20%, from Jun 2.
In the poll the distance to the leader did NOT change: it was 5 points and it is still 5 points, because both rose 1 point.
The 1-point gain sits inside the house's own 2pp margin, so it is not distinguishable from stability.
In the runoff he remains 3 points behind, 44% against 47%, exactly as in the previous round.

His campaign spent the day in a dispute with a rival from his own side: he accused Caiado of helping the leader, after Kassab said Caiado has zero chance, and Kassab replied that his campaign is worried about Caiado, according to Estadão.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 32.55% (vol USD 8.63M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC), up 0.50pp and a SIXTH day running of gains. ⭐ He is solely responsible for the narrowing of the distance over the last two days, because the leader stood still. ⛔ NOT A RECORD: of the 88 days in the series since May 22, 2 posted a value equal to or above 32.55%, and the high is still 33.20%, from Jun 2. 📌 ON THE BOARD he decided to limit his participation in first round debates and to attend only when Lula is present, according to Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo. 📊 In a STATE poll in the Federal District he stands at 44% against 39% in the runoff; state polls do not enter the national panel. In the national ballot box BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 has him at 36% in the first round and 44% in the runoff.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 4.05% (vol USD 10.14M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC)
fortes: He still leads the first-round third place contract, at 52.50%, the highest probability in that book.
His contract has the LARGEST accumulated volume in the presidential book, at USD 9.95M, above the leader's own.
Today's BTG/Nexus keeps him at 4% in the first round, the same level as recent national polls.
He opened his campaign in São Paulo on Aug 16 with a security-focused speech, according to O Globo and G1.
He publicly assessed that Pablo Marçal's possible entry into the race would benefit his rival on the right, and not him.
fracos: 🔻 DOWN in price, from 4.40% to 4.05%, giving back what he gained the previous day. The value is still close to the low: 86 of the 88 days recorded since May 22 are above it, and the low was touched on Aug 18, at 3.60%.

⚠️ His book is THIN, and that matters for reading the move: in the presidential contract he is worth a little over 4%, and in that range little money moves the price. The placement reading, in the third place contract, is where he carries real weight.
In the third place contract he also gave ground, from 53.00% to 52.50%, and the distance to the second name in that book narrowed from 15.50pp to 14.00pp.
🔴 IN THE POLL HE IS BEHIND CAIADO: today's BTG/Nexus gives Caiado 5% and him 4%.
His series high is 17.90%, from Jun 9, meaning today's price is less than a quarter of that value.
candidates.analise: PRICE at 4.05% (vol USD 10.14M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC), down 0.35pp, giving back what he gained the previous day. ⚠️ He remains close to the low: 86 of the 88 days in the series are above 4.05%, and the low was touched on Aug 18, at 3.60%. ⭐ IN THE THIRD PLACE CONTRACT he was STABLE at 57.00% and still WIDENED his lead, from 20.00pp to 21.00pp, because the one who gave ground was Ronaldo Caiado. 📌 The disagreement with the ballot box continues unresolved: BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 gives Caiado 5% and him 4%, while the market keeps him 21 points ahead on placement. These are different questions: the poll measures declared intention, the contract measures probability of placement.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE for the whole pack, confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC): Pablo Marçal 0.75% (vol USD 1.72M), Ronaldo Caiado 0.55% (vol USD 6.35M), Romeu Zema 0.15% (vol USD 5.72M), Fernando Haddad 0.05% and Tarcísio de Freitas 0.05% (vol USD 13.95M, the largest in the book).
candidates.subtitle: Aug 16, first day of campaigning: all three opened their schedules, and in the price all three fell. The crossing that matters is about CONTRACTS, because Caiado goes down on victory and up on placing.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), Poly presidential 0.55% (vol USD 6.35M accumulated, confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC)), down 0.25pp | third place in the first round at 36.00% | polling in force: Quaest 4%, Gerp 4%, Meio/Ideia 5.7%, BTG/Nexus 5% | REJECTION of 35% in the Quaest of Aug 14
caiado.fortes: ⭐ His THIRD-PLACE contract stands at 37.50%, against 31.00% at the Aug 12 close, a 6.50pp rise with four straight higher closes. In other words, the market moved him closer on PLACING while moving him away from VICTORY. In the polling he still has 4% in the Quaest of Aug 14 and the lowest rejection in the field, 35%. He opened the campaign with a mass at the Goiânia cathedral and a motorcade through Goiás and the Federal District outskirts, according to Folha de S.Paulo and G1, and said the United States does not rule Brazil, according to Times Brasil.
caiado.fracos: In the victory price he fell 0.45pp and moved to 0.60%, brushing the 0.5% cutoff. ⚠️ The 35% rejection comes with high name-recognition gaps declared by the house itself, and low rejection with high unfamiliarity is not acceptance: it means most of the electorate has not yet formed an opinion, and an unformed opinion can go either way. His contrast remains the widest on the panel, with 4% to 5.7% of declared intention against less than 1% of victory price.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), Poly presidential 0.05%, confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC), below the 0.5% cut
haddad.fortes: His cumulative volume remains larger than that of several names priced above him, which keeps the contract with trading depth despite the floor-level price. He spoke at the president's campaign-opening rally in the ABC region, according to O Globo.
haddad.fracos: ⭐ The caveat the panel had been repeating as an inference became a DATED FACT on Aug 16: he formally opened a campaign for the GOVERNORSHIP OF SÃO PAULO, according to O Globo and Times Brasil. That is, he is not a presidential candidate, and any presidential scenario that includes him is a polling hypothesis, not a candidacy under way. No national poll in the window tests him. The price fell to 0.05%, and variation in that band carries no informational value.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), Poly presidential 0.15% (vol USD 5.72M accumulated, confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC)), unchanged and below the 0.5% cut | third place in the first round at 4.85%
zema.fortes: The Quaest of Aug 14 keeps him at 2% in the first round, the same value as Aug 5, and BTG/Nexus's 3% and Meio/Ideia's 2.6% still stand. He was the first of the chasing pack to file with the electoral court, on Aug 6. He opened the campaign with a mass in Montes Claros, in northern Minas Gerais, promising a maximum-security prison and criticising Supreme Court justices, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Valor Econômico.
zema.fracos: 🔴 The Quaest firmness crosstab released on Aug 15 shows he has the LEAST CONVINCED electorate in the field, according to G1, which speaks to how solid his support is rather than how large. In the price he fell 0.20pp and moved to 0.15%, below the 0.5% cutoff. In the third-place contract he has 5.00%, far behind the 53.00% of the chasing pack's leader.

candidates.analise: ⚠️ RONALDO CAIADO GAVE BACK WHAT HE HAD GAINED. In the contract on WINNING he fell from 0.80% to 0.55% (vol USD 6.35M), confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC), undoing the previous day's rise, and in the THIRD PLACE one he gave ground from 37.00% to 36.00%. ⛔ No superlative: 85 of the 86 days in the series since May 22 are above 0.55%, and the high is 2.40%, from Jun 19. The PSD confirmed his presidential candidacy. 🏷️ PABLO MARÇAL fell to 0.75% (vol USD 1.72M), with volume still rising, from USD 1.66M to USD 1.72M in one day. He remains INELIGIBLE until 2032, with campaigning allowed by injunction and registration pending, and Datafolha of Aug 21 is the FIRST to measure him: today he has a price and no ballot-box measurement. ROMEU ZEMA stays at 0.15%, below the 0.5% cut. TARCÍSIO remains a candidate for re-election as governor of São Paulo and HADDAD for governor of São Paulo, with their contracts at the floor and Tarcísio's carrying USD 13.95M, the largest volume in the whole presidential book.
fortes: ⭐ CAIADO ROSE IN THE POSITION CONTRACT: first-round third place went from 37.50% to 38.50%, and his distance to the leader of that book closed from 15.50pp to 14.00pp.
In today's BTG/Nexus Caiado has 5% in the first round, ABOVE Renan Santos's 4%, inverting the ordering the market prices.
Zema has 4% in the same BTG/Nexus, tied with Renan Santos inside the 2pp margin.
The runner-up's campaign treated Caiado as a problem on the same day: Kassab said the campaign is worried about Caiado, according to Estadão.

Pablo Marçal is priced at 0.90%, with USD 1.21M accumulated, and will be included in the Datafolha survey scheduled for Aug 21, according to Valor Econômico. 🏷️ He filed for registration and is among the 13 who did so, and an injunction cleared him to campaign, but he is INELIGIBLE until 2032 and the registration remains pending a decision by the electoral court, according to BBC, G1 and Folha de S.Paulo.
fracos: 🔻 Caiado FELL in the win contract, from 0.80% to 0.55%, undoing the previous day's rise, and stays above the 0.5% cut, but barely.
Zema remains at 0.25%, below the 0.5% cut the panel uses to separate price from noise.
Both win contracts in the pack sit at a level where a one-hundredth change already shifts the relative percentage, and the panel treats that as shape, not signal.
Kassab, who is the running mate on Caiado's ticket, publicly said he has zero chance in the election, and then said he had been misinterpreted, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Estadão.
Zema opened the week promising a maximum-security prison and criticising Supreme Court justices, and that still has no translation into price, with 4.95% in the third place contract.

cruzamento: ⭐ THE MOVE OF THE DAY HAS ONLY ONE SIDE, AND THAT IS THE FINDING. In the confirmed reading of Aug 19, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC), LULA repeated 63.50% (vol USD 8.69M), unchanged for a second day running, and FLÁVIO BOLSONARO rose 0.50pp to 32.55% (vol USD 8.63M), on a sixth day running of gains. The distance between them narrowed to 30.95pp, the THIRD day running of convergence: it was 37.05pp on Aug 16, 33.05pp on Aug 17 and 31.45pp on Aug 18, that is 6.10pp in three days. 🔑 THE ONE NARROWING THE DISTANCE IS NOT THE ONE FALLING. The leader lost no price at all in two days; the entire convergence came from the runner-up rising. ⛔ NO SUPERLATIVE: 32.55% is NOT a record. Of the 88 days in the series since May 22, 2 posted a value equal to or above it, and the high is still 33.20%, from Jun 2. 📌 AND THE BALLOT BOX STAYS SILENT about it: no new national poll since Aug 17, and that one measured the distance between the two UNCHANGED at 5 points. A measurement that does not narrow cannot explain a narrowing of 6.10pp. ⚠️ RONALDO CAIADO GAVE BACK WHAT HE HAD GAINED: from 0.80% to 0.55% (vol USD 6.35M), undoing the previous day's rise, and in the third place contract he gave ground from 37.00% to 36.00%. His distance to Renan Santos in that book widened further, from 20.00pp to 21.00pp. ⛔ No superlative here either: 85 of the 86 days in the series are above 0.55%. 📊 The two polls of the day are STATE polls and do not enter the national panel: Real Time Big Data in the Federal District, with Flávio Bolsonaro at 44% and Lula at 39% in the runoff, and Datafolha in São Paulo. 📅 The NATIONAL Datafolha comes out on Aug 21 and is the first to include Pablo Marçal, who today has a price of 0.75% and no ballot-box measurement.
